record.provider: Baseten Delivery Network (BDN) model weight mirrors

free_tier.stated: No published per-account storage number. BDN 'mirrors model weights to Baseten and caches them near your replicas'; there is no documented quota and no free tier stated. Sized for 'a few GB or less' (weights that can be bundled directly with a Truss) up to multi-GB weight sources.

egress.terms: Not applicable. BDN is a read-only cache mounted into your own replicas ('mounted read-only'), not a public download surface. No anonymous URL.

record.tooling: `baseten model push` (Truss), management API POST /v1/prepare_model_upload ('Validates a model push payload and issues upload credentials'), config.yaml `weights:` / `bdn:` keys.
record.chaining: Private artifact cache within an inference platform. Anonymous bulk read access is not supported.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: not published; the system expects weights in the GB range, not the 100 GB+ range. Retention: cached by config hash, evicted by the platform ('Caching and deduplication happen behind the scenes'). No free allowance stated.
record.reliability_note: Requires an organisation account and a paid inference deployment to exist before weights are cached; withdrawing the deployment removes the mount.

evidence.proved: 'Mirror and cache model weights ... mounted read-only'; 'If your model is small (a few GB or less) you can also bundle weights directly with your Truss'
POST /v1/prepare_model_upload 'Validates a model push payload and issues upload credentials'
